messages:
Marta (CS): Hey team :wave: LumenBridge onboarding — account health mostly OK but we've seen 3 p95 latency spikes this week (baseline p95=1.8s -> spikes up to 3.6s). Renewal check-in in ~6w; customer flagged cost and jitter as main concerns. Proactive idea: int8 quantized model swap + routing to a dedicated pool during US biz hours, plus prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/lumenbridge/metrics

Devin (SE): Agree. We have a verified int8 variant `gptx-base-int8` that usually saves cost and reduces tail latency. Quick config suggestion: 
```
model: gptx-base-int8
routing:
  policy: region-prefer
  prefer_pool: lumenbridge-dedicated-us-east
canary: 5%
```
In our bench, token cost ~-35% and p95 improved ~10-15% for similar prompt mixes.

Sam (SRE): +1 to canary. Also recommend bumping autoscaling headroom for the pool during 09:00-18:00 ET to avoid queueing on cold starts. Example: `max_burst_instances: 40`. We'll watch KV cache hit-rate (if low, enable prefix caching heuristics).

Chloe (PM): I'll schedule a 30-min enablement demo next Tue with the customer to walk tradeoffs and capture feedback. Can someone prepare a short before/after perf slide and an eval harness with ~10 prompts? :memo: 

Marta (CS): I'll collect 10 representative prompts and the customer's expected SLAs. For renewal risk mitigation, propose offering a 30-day trial of dedicated routing + quantized config (no extra charge) so they can see cost/latency benefits. Thoughts?

Devin (SE): Rollout plan: 1) deploy int8 canary (5%) -> monitor P50/P95 and error rate; 2) if stable after 24-48h, increase to 50%; 3) full cutover. Monitoring hooks: 
- metrics: `latency.p50`, `latency.p95`, `token_cost.avg`
- alerts: fire if p95 rises >10% vs baseline OR error_rate >0.5%
Also add automated rollback if regression detected.

Sam (SRE): I'll open the routing change PR and add a temporary pool with the suggested headroom. Will add tracing hooks so we can tag canary traffic and measure side-by-side. Tagging @deploy-bot for canary rollout readiness.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for canary at 2026-05-03T15:10:00Z — pipeline: `canary/int8-lumenbridge` :robot_face: 

Chloe (PM): Awesome. Marta — please capture the customer's feedback during the enablement call (ease of integration, perceived latency, quality regressions, cost impressions) and paste a 3-bullet summary here afterwards. We'll fold that into the renewal playbook.

Marta (CS): Will do. I'll post a one-paragraph recap and any example prompts where quality changed within 24h post-call. Also planning to ask product for a short note on potential quality mitigations (prompt tweaks, light re-scaling) in case we see small regressions. :thumbsup:
